sample_space.description: Experiments mount on the 530 mm diameter mixing-chamber plate at the bottom of the insert (base < 7 mK, controllable to 30 K). Line-of-sight access from the top plate down to the MXC plate is through 2 side-loading Secondary Inserts, each with a 117 mm x 252 mm rectangular port (configured here as ISO100-2: two ISO100 ports per SI), plus 4 x KF25 ports. Secondary Inserts slide in from the side of the frame and are exchangeable between Proteox systems.
sample_space.shape: circular plate; two 117 x 252 mm rectangular line-of-sight columns

notes: ProteoxLX: twin-PTR cryogen-free dilution refrigerator, 530 mm MXC plate, < 7 mK base, > 25 uW at 20 mK, > 850 uW at 100 mK, 7 mK to 30 K control range (qd-oxford.com/products/proteoxLX.html). Stage stack per the Proteox high-temperature app note: stainless top plate (vacuum enclosure) -> PT1 -> PT2 -> still -> cold plate -> mixing chamber, with gas-gap heat switches and a remote sorption pump weakly coupled to PT2. Line of sight: 2 x Secondary Insert (117 x 252 mm) + 4 x KF25. This configuration (ISO100-2 SI, no magnet, no windows) has no optical windows and no bottom loader. Helium-3 requirement for LX is 50 L per the family brochure table (qd-oxford.com/siteDocs/The_Proteox_Family_Brochure.pdf). Outer dimensions are genuinely unpublished (searched qd-oxford, oxinst redirects, directindustry 403, Japanese QD pages, facility pages); the renderer must not treat the 0 height as real. PT1/still/cold-plate temperatures come from the QSHS axion paper (arXiv 2504.12257) describing a Proteox MX500 and are flagged as sibling-platform data.
